title: Sphere support without margin
summary: Recovered VA 0x47d530: a thiscall member clears all four float output lanes to positive zero and returns the output pointer. Sphere state and direction are unused. Vtable slot +0x3c and caller 0x47d5bf confirm the output/direction argument order and returned vector storage.
test_description: Direct original-reference comparison over five bit-pattern sets (ordinary values, signed zero, subnormals, infinities, quiet/signaling NaNs, extrema), four rounding modes, separate/aliased/null direction. Assert returned pointer, all 16 zero output bytes, output guards, unchanged direction and sphere storage, MXCSR and installed FS head.
known_limits: Sphere object layout and unrelated methods are intentionally not reconstructed; this method accesses no object fields.
Null or invalid output pointers and inaccessible/unaligned output storage are outside the portable C++ contract; original performs unchecked dword writes.
No claim of matching compiled machine code or full physics integration.
